# 蒸馏与开源模型生态全景图谱

## 1. 开源 vs 闭源模型生态概览
```mermaid
flowchart TD
    OpenModel["开源模型"] -->|提供权重| Community["社区贡献"]
    ClosedModel["闭源模型"] -->|提供API| API_Sales["API 销售"]
    OpenModel -->|降低推理成本| Cost_Inference["推理成本↓"]
    ClosedModel -->|硬件+溢价成本| Cost_Inference
    Cost_Inference -->|影响| Token_Pricing["Token 价格"]
    API_Sales -->|驱动| Token_Pricing
    OpenModel -->|灵活部署| Commercial_Use["商业部署"]
    ClosedModel -->|受限部署| Commercial_Use
    OpenModel -->|数据收集| Data_Collection["数据抓取争议"]
    ClosedModel -->|数据保密| Data_Collection
    Data_Collection -->|引发| Security_Risk["安全风险争议"]
    Community -->|促进| Innovation["技术创新"]
    Innovation -->|提升| Model_Performance["模型性能"]
    Model_Performance -->|影响| Market_Competition["市场竞争"]
```

## 2. 蒸馏（Distillation）技术与争议
```mermaid
flowchart TD
    LargeModel["大模型（教师）"] -->|输出概率分布| Logits["Logits / 概率"]
    SmallModel["小模型（学生）"] -->|学习| Logits
    ClosedModel["闭源大模型"] -->|不可见| Logits
    OpenModel["开源大模型"] -->|可获取| Logits
    Logits -->|用于| Knowledge_Transfer["知识转移"]
    Knowledge_Transfer -->|实现| Distillation["蒸馏"]
    Distillation -->|声称提升| Capability["模型能力提升"]
    Capability -->|被质疑| Claim_Distillation["蒸馏真实性"]
    Claim_Distillation -->|证据薄弱| Evidence_Weak["证据薄弱"]
    Evidence_Weak -->|导致| Legal_Concern["法律/伦理争议"]
    Legal_Concern -->|涉及| Security_Risk
```

## 3. K3 模型发布与生态冲击
```mermaid
flowchart TD
    K3_Release["K3 权重公开 (7/27)"] -->|展示| Performance["前沿性能"]
    Performance -->|逼近| ClosedFrontier["闭源前沿模型"]
    K3_Release -->|触发| Industry_Debate["行业争论"]
    Industry_Debate -->|关注| Distillation["蒸馏指控"]
    Industry_Debate -->|关注| Security["安全风险"]
    K3_Release -->|采用| License["KIMI 商业授权"]
    License -->|设定| Revenue_Threshold["年收入 >2000万"]
    License -->|要求| Agreement["商业协议"]
    License -->|促进| Ecosystem["生态合作（云厂商、合作伙伴）"]
    Ecosystem -->|提升| Token_Sales["Token 销售"]
    Token_Sales -->|影响| Market_Valuation["公司估值"]
    Market_Valuation -->|反馈| ClosedModel_Strategy["闭源模型商业策略"]
```

## 4. 成本、效率与安全的相互关系
```mermaid
flowchart TD
    OpenSource["开源模型"] -->|模型更小| Size["模型规模↓"]
    Size -->|降低| Hardware_Cost["硬件成本↓"]
    Hardware_Cost -->|降低| Inference_Cost["推理成本↓"]
    Inference_Cost -->|降低| Token_Pricing
    OpenSource -->|技术创新| Efficiency_Tech["高效技术 (KDA, RWKV, Linear Attention)"]
    Efficiency_Tech -->|提升| Performance
    Performance -->|提升| Capability
    Capability -->|可能引发| Security_Risk
    ClosedModel -->|高溢价| Token_Pricing
    ClosedModel -->|限制| Data_Access["数据访问受限"]
    Data_Access -->|降低| Security_Risk
    Security_Risk -->|驱动| Regulation["监管与政策讨论"]
    Regulation -->|影响| Deployment["部署决策"]
```
